content.ascii:
[A] GridBox / LineGridScene
=====================================================
[LineGridScene]
  contents[contentId] --> Diagram
  root --> GridBox
[GridBox]
  id + position{column,row} + minimumSize?
  collapsed + collapsedContentId?
    +-- diagram   --> contentId
    '-- container --> children[] + push-right gap
             |
[resolveScene]
  relative cells --> absolute bounds + children
  zero-based coordinates; right/bottom exclusive
  collapsed --> summary; children hidden
  expanded --> content / children / minimumSize
             |
[updateGridBox --> layoutScene --> composeScene]
  anchor changed subtree; settle siblings rightward
  validate bounds + collisions before publication
  hitTest --> boxId / contentId? / local cell
  projectMapping --> 1-based local mapping to cells
Source: lineGrid.ts
